title: Owen's count
style: cinematic horror film still, old car ferry crossing a black harbor at night, thick drifting sea fog, sodium deck lights, wet steel, rope and rust, cold teal and amber tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. Tonight the count is wrong the other way. One passenger is missing. ➖

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Owen learned his extra passengers were the twenty-four lost in 1961, and the last one still out there was his own grandfather.
scenes.image: empty picture frame on a dim museum wall

scenes.narration: Tonight the fog is the thickest Owen has ever seen. He can't see the bow from the ramp.
scenes.image: ferry ramp swallowed by fog so dense the ship's bow is invisible, a single lamp glowing

scenes.narration: Twenty-three passengers board. He counts them twice. Twenty-three.
scenes.image: deckhand at a ramp clicking a tally counter as passengers in coats pass in the fog

scenes.narration: The crossing is wrong from the start. The engine sounds far away. The horn sounds like it's underwater. The deck lights turn a weak yellow, like an old photograph.
scenes.image: ferry deck at night lit by dim yellow lamps, fog thick, everything tinted like an old photo

scenes.narration: Halfway across, the boat lurches. Hard. Like it brushed against something big beneath the surface. Marta doesn't slow down.
scenes.image: passengers on ferry benches thrown sideways, gripping the seats, fog outside the windows

scenes.narration: They dock. Owen clicks them off. Twenty. Twenty-one. Twenty-two.
scenes.image: close-up of a tally clicker in a deckhand's hand, passengers' feet stepping off a ramp

scenes.narration: He waits. Nobody else comes. Ten seconds. Thirty. A full minute.
scenes.image: empty ferry ramp in fog, a deckhand standing alone at its foot, waiting

scenes.narration: He runs back on board. Empty benches. Empty cabin. And along the rail, a trail of wet footprints, walking calmly to the edge. And stopping.
scenes.image: trail of wet footprints on a ferry deck leading to the railing and ending there, black water below

scenes.narration: Twenty-two. Not one extra. One missing. He counts again. Still twenty-two.
scenes.image: deckhand gripping a wet ferry railing staring down into black foggy water

scenes.narration: Marta is standing behind him on the dark deck. Her voice is calm. Oh, Owen. You weren't supposed to count tonight. Tonight, they're counting us.
scenes.image: silhouette of a ferry captain standing on a dark deck behind a young deckhand, fog swirling
